text: In twenty twenty-two, the world's largest asset manager made a prediction.
Every asset, it was said, could be tokenized.
There was just one problem.
Four years later…
…less than zero point two percent had arrived.
And real estate, the largest asset class on earth, barely moved at all.
Behind the headlines: real tenants, real investors, real money lost.
Because real estate still runs on PDFs, spreadsheets and paper.
Every buyer re-verifies every asset. From scratch. For months.
A dozen intermediaries stand between capital and the asset, each one re-checking the same data.
Public markets automated decades ago, because their data allowed it.
The token was never the problem.
The data was.
Propchain is the missing layer.
Every source, from scanned registries to rent rolls, structured into one machine-readable standard.
Attested on chain, so origin, permission and state are provable by anyone.
So AI agents can finally act on it: identified, permissioned, audited.
When an allocator sets a mandate, its agent finds, verifies, finances and settles…
…in minutes. Not months.
Already live, across more than eleven thousand units.
Propchain. Structuring real estate for the autonomous era.
